tests.safe: Off, unpowered, mis-programmed or broken, the block cannot damage, load, latch or lock up anything else.
tests.clean: DRC and LVS pass; an extracted simulation shows basic function at one nominal operating point.
tests.observable: Internal state visible from the bench via SPI status, ATB, clock observe or a data tap.
tests.fallback: At least one other route performs the function without sharing the likely failure mode.

external_blocks.board: Board passives, external clocks, LNA/PA and PHY options; not fabricated.

rf_lo_external_ref.route: Passive external quadrature LO: board I on REF_IN and Q on AUX_CLK (sine, ~2 Vpp per leg at the pad, AC-coupled), switched and biased straight onto the RX and TX mixer gates (pt_lo_ext). No active device in the path.
rf_lo_external_ref.status: pass: extracted, 2.45 GHz, 12/12 envelope corners at 4 Vpp open-circuit source; square-wave drive fails (node pumps), board must supply sine

clk_stop_and_external.route: Every clock mux defaults to a stopped input; each clock domain can take REF_IN or AUX_CLK directly with the PLLs off.

rf_lna_bypass.route: Series switch from the protected RF_RX node to the mixer input with the LNA off; external board LNA supplies gain.

rf_bb_stage_bypass.route: Per-stage bypass switches around the PGA and channel filter.

rf_bb_external_adc.route: Buffered I/Q baseband, selectable after the mixer, PGA or filter, out to an external ADC.

rf_rx_external_downconverter.route: Board downconverter drives external baseband into BB_I/BB_Q, injected at the PGA input; on-chip PGA, filter and ADC complete the chain.

rf_tx_external_baseband.route: External DAC baseband injected through BB_I/BB_Q into the TX filter input or directly into the upmixer.

rf_tx_external_upconverter.route: On-chip DAC and TX filter output reach BB_I/BB_Q through the tap buffer; a board upconverter and PA complete the transmitter.

rf_tx_low_power_external_pa.route: Driver output stage off; summer output reaches RF_TX through a bypass switch at low power for an external PA.

wire_clk_external_ref.route: Serial bit clock taken directly from REF_IN at full rate (external synthesizer).

wire_clk_wclk_in.route: Serial clock from the east WCLK_IN pair.

wire_tx_external_data.route: External differential serial data on WTX_EXT_P/N drives the WIRE_TX output stage directly.
wire_tx_external_data.status: diff_clk_rx data mode: 0 errors at 0.5-1.6 Gb/s, 300-800 mVpp, AC-coupled, with >=128 balanced preamble bits (B12), using OUTN inverted. The mux path works to 1 Gb/s with an ideal receiver. The combined extracted route is not yet simulated.

wire_cdr_external_clock.route: Slicer samples on WCLK_IN; raw words to the FPGA over D2H; FPGA performs phase selection.

wire_cdr_fpga_oversample.route: At low rates (USB FS, OOB, slow serial), slicer output is oversampled and recovered in the FPGA.

wire_ctle_bypass.route: CTLE bypass switch; external board equalizer if needed.

wire_wmon_scope.route: Buffered, bandwidth-limited front-end output on WMON for scope observation and low-rate external slicing.

wire_board_termination.route: On-chip termination off; board resistors (external passives are allowed).

wire_detect_via_wmon.route: Line state observed on WMON and through the ATB; FPGA decides.

usb_board_phy.route: Off-die: board USB PHY to the FPGA. The chip's USB branches stay off.

usb_fs_via_slicer.route: FS/LS line state through slicer comparators and SPI-polled detectors; board pull resistors.

rf_lo_aux_clk.route: AUX_CLK_P/N clock input. In passive-LO mode it carries the Q LO (route rf_lo_external_ref). Otherwise it is an independent differential clock selectable by debug.clk_select for the converter/sample and wired clock domains.
